title: Fantastic experience with an amazing view
text:
This was a very fun and affordable experience watching the chef make paella while explaining each ingredient and the order in which you do things. There was meat, cheese, & olives waiting for us and we were served a glass of wine of our choice. We were served the paella out on the rooftop with a spectacular view!

Our chef was very easy to understand (English) and a lot of fun. She also handled the group of 9 very well when some of them were talking loudly, watching things on their phones, and challenging her on a lot of things.

author: Janette_E

title: Fine.
text: Maria is very nice, sweet and sociable she speaks good English and also gives tips for nearby possibly. The show wasn't spectacular don't call it show cooking but an explanation of how to make paella. Started at 5.30pm early for Spanish standards and by 7pm we were already done.
author: W573CQnathalieg

title: Highly recommend this Paella Showcooking experience!
text: The Paella Showcooking experience was both very interesting and enjoyable. Chef Eyrian did an excellent job of demonstrating how to cook  paella.  She was also very personable and welcoming.  The paella was delicious, as was the Sangria!
author: Janis_O

title: If You Enjoy Cooking, Don’t Miss This One
text: Presented in a beautiful and meticulously clean kitchen by a gracious and knowledgeable hostess. You will learn how to make traditional seafood paella and enjoy it on a roof top patio overlooking the city.
author: Joe_C

title: Paella like a professional chef.
text:
Fantastic kitchen well equipped for cooking class. 
Instructor, Fabio, was excellent. 
Got detailed instructions on making a seafood paella. 
Highly recommended.
author: Lloyd_M

title: Fantastic experience
text:
The demonstration of making paella was entertaining, informative, educational, and delicious. From start to finish the whole experience was one of our favorite times in our vacation in Sevilla.
Fabio was fabulous!
author: Janet_Z

title: Paella demo
text: This Paella demonstration was awesome, great company, the paella turned out great, and also learned a few things about cooking. The chef was very knowledgeable and patient. I would definitely recommend this event.
author: aliciavamos

title: Great experience,...
text: Great experience, spectacular view of the river, Fabio the chef was super nice and the food was delicious, couldn’t reccomend more
author: James_D

title: Great dinner experience
text: I don’t even eat seafood but my partner does. The rice was amazing. He loved the entire dish! The experience with the explanation of the spices and history of the dish.
author: Katheryn_K

title: Great food and rooftop
text: Great paella and our chef was great with giving information about the dish! It was, also,  on a great rooftop that showed a beautiful view of the city
